measurement_note: Enter values from the actual nameplate and measured ACIM parameters. rated_phase_voltage_v is the physical winding voltage: equal to line voltage for Delta and line/sqrt(3) for Star. controller_equivalent_phase_voltage_v is always MCSDK phase-to-neutral voltage (line/sqrt(3)); it is required for a physical Delta motor. Do not copy the synthetic identification example or catalog-only values.
